fusions.name: Swarm Over
fusions.desc: Swarms every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Survivor's Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps for 9 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Fill the Hold
fusions.desc: Calls a pack of hounds for 15 seconds. They bite an enemy within 5 tiles every 1 second, dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
